name: Solo MCP
description: Solo uses knowledge from the codebase and other product sources (e.g. linear, jira, confluence, notion, etc) to keep your help docs accurate and answer technical product questions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Solo MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Solo MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.asksolo.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Solo MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solo MCP provides these MCP tools: search_product_context, suggested_documentation_updates, and update_documentation_via_task.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Solo MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Solo MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Solo MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solo MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Solo MCP is developed by Anik Rahman. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
